summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for Admin Customer Intelligence Live Radar enhancements. New overview fields, serialization safety, admin auth gates, and UI panels/drawer/map/segments all passed. One auth CORS preflight contract issue remains.

critical.issue: Response missing access-control-allow-credentials=true for credentialed CORS preflight; explicit allow-origin+credentials contract still failing.

action_items: Fix preview edge/ingress CORS preflight handling for /api/auth/login OPTIONS to include access-control-allow-credentials=true and explicit access-control-allow-origin.
Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_admin_customer_intelligence.py after CORS fix to confirm auth hardening contract is fully green.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin Customer Intelligence overview now returns radar_alerts, segments, heatmap, privacy_policy and preserves existing contract keys.
No Mongo ObjectId/_id serialization leaks detected in tested overview/detail payloads, including segments and heatmap cells.
Auth lockout behavior matched required 5x401 then 429 pattern when using isolated test identifier; prior all-429 run was stale lockout state contamination.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI login selector uses placeholders in current build (no stable login data-testid observed during run). Admin path /admin/customer-intelligence loaded and verified: radar alerts panel, privacy panel, segments panel, heatmap cells, summary/map/yearly/monthly/customer drawer. Backend tests extended to assert new radar/segments/heatmap/privacy contract fields and serialization safety.
rca of the issue: CORS middleware in app is configured with allow_credentials=True and explicit origins, but deployed OPTIONS response at preview URL omits access-control-allow-credentials. This indicates upstream preflight interception/override (edge/ingress) rather than route-level admin-customer-intelligence regression. Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin + Access-Control-Request-* headers.
